name: japan-map
description: 日本の 3D 地図（www.ortho-earth.com/japan/ の表の頁）と、日本を試料に使うエンジンの検定・焼きの道具。自前の Worker は持たない＝出力 dist/site/japan/ を apps/japan-host（Worker ortho-japan）が集めて配る（2026-10-24 に apps/ortho-japan から改名）。SDK（@ortho-earth/japan）は sdk/japan。
author: Kenji Yoshida <kenji.yoshida.home.2026@gmail.com>

scripts.test: node demo/samples/test-scene-adapter.mjs && node tests/t-dtm.mjs && node tests/t-vocab.mjs && node tests/t-region.mjs && node tests/t-tier.mjs && node tests/t-pbrdecode.mjs && node tests/t-poioverrides.mjs && node tests/t-landmarks.mjs && node tests/t-meshq.mjs
scripts.verify:japan: npm run verify:ui && npm run verify:webgpu
scripts.verify:editor: node scripts/verify-editor.mjs t-editor t-editor-mobile t-zoomfill t-import
